title: Start a fresh chat
text: Each work card has a conversation. Start fresh chat opens another conversation on the same card. A coding agent reads the project files and responds to the message.

title: Edit in a separate folder
text: A work card can share its folder with another card. To change files independently, open Directory and select Edit in a separate folder. Begin a chat in the new directory.

title: Retry a failed trial
text: A logical trial occupies one budget slot. Each execution attempt has an outcome. A retry creates another attempt for the same trial and preserves the execution history.

title: Bring comparison results into a conversation
text: Open the results table. Select a baseline and a second candidate. The comparison shows the difference between their scores. Choose a destination work card and add the comparison to its chat draft.

title: Install the OptPilot evaluation guide
text: In Skills select the coding agent and current project. Install the evaluation guide. The agent discovers the guide in the project's native skills folder and can prepare evaluation definitions.

title: Save a version
text: A saved version captures declared inputs, including source code and data. An evaluation records which versions it used. Editing project files later leaves the original run reproducible.
